fields.label: Reason for Applying
fields.description: FCE's work and training focuses on "renewing the mind" (Rom. 12:1-2). Answer these questions about your spiritual and personal life honestly.

fields.label: What is your motivation for applying for this training?
How did you find out about this training?
fields.options:
Parent/Guardian
Friend
An FCE or UFCE student
Pastor, church member, or spiritual mentor
Social media post
Booth at a missions/church conference
Other

fields.label: Referral person or organisation
fields.description: (Optional) If you found out about the training from a person or organisation, please share their name.

fields.label: What are your expectations for this training?
When and how did you become a follower of Christ?
What are the things the Lord is teaching you at the moment?
Have you responded to God's calling to make disciples of all nations?
fields.description: If yes, please give a brief account of your calling and the guidance you received.

fields.description: Must be a valid email address.

fields.label: Primary phone number
fields.description: Include country code with a plus sign at the start, e.g. +27 12 345 6789

fields.label: Highest grade level obtained in secondary school
fields.description: E.g. Grade 12, O-levels, etc.

fields.label: Date work ended
fields.description: Leave blank if you are presently employed.

fields.label: Emergency Contact Information
fields.description: In case you experience an emergency situation during your training with FCE, who should we contact? Please double-check that the information is accurate.

fields.label: Primary Phone Number for Emergency Contact
Secondary Phone Number for Emergency Contact
How would you describe your social support network?
fields.description: Where do you find social and emotional support? Perhaps this may include your family, a local church community, etc.

fields.label: Do you have anyone supporting your decision to get involved in discipleship?
fields.description: This includes socially, emotionally, and/or financially. If yes, please give details.

fields.label: Are you currently associated with a local church group?
Local Church Group Info
fields.description: Optional

fields.label: Years of Membership
fields.description: How many years have you been a member at this church?

fields.label: Your Involvement at the Local Church
fields.description: Describe your involvement in the local church.

fields.label: Does your Pastor/Minister approve of you being trained by FCE?
Local Church Financial Support
fields.description: Will your church be willing to support you financially whilst in training?

fields.options:
Yes
No
Not sure
Not applicable

fields.label: Finances and Payment
fields.description: PLEASE NOTE: We do not encourage debt and we do not want you to go into debt to pay for this training. We also do not want you to pay for this training and then you cannot keep up with liabilities elsewhere.

fields.label: Sufficient Financial Resources for Training
fields.description: Do you have sufficient financial resources for your training?

fields.label: Source of Funds
fields.description: If you answered yes, list who is responsible for supplying the finances. If no, how do you intend to raise the funds?

fields.label: Payment Plan
fields.options:
Pay 100% on day of registration
Pay in monthly installments through training's duration
fields.description: Indicate one of the following payment plans. NB! No late payments are allowed.

fields.label: Agreements
fields.description: Carefully read all of the following agreements and respond accordingly.

fields.label: Financial Agreement
fields.description: Read the financial agreement. If you understand and agree with it, type Yes in the field below.

fields.label: Consent for Treatment Signature
fields.description: If you agree with the Consent for Treatment Agreement, type your full name on the line below.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: Read the agreement. If you understand and agree with it, type Yes in the field below.
